objective: Implement a small normalized monotone/thermal joint history comparator; compare explicit geometric codebooks against exact finite-state marginalization and an unretired path-sum oracle.

model.kind: finite-state numerical comparator, not calibrated continuous battery posterior
model.health: reference capacity loss and R0 growth, each 0/0.15/0.30 of declared reference
model.aging: continuous-time pure-birth generator with separate Q/R and shared damage jumps; rates supplied, not inferred; forward moves only, absorbing at design-envelope edges
model.rate_interpretation: Engineering qualification assumptions. Slow and accelerated stress profiles are separate. No ten-year aging-rate calibration or hidden exponential forgetting.
model.temperature: measured piecewise-linear history; separate uncertain reversible linear-in-temperature Q/R laws anchored at25C; common measured thermal activity modulates supplied aging rates
model.carried_state: SOC distribution transported using actual held-current durations and current effective capacity; positive barycentric deposition onto a declared SOC grid
model.nuisance: three public joint RC/H/gamma/entering-state candidates; uncertainty retained across all observations, never fixed to synthetic truth
model.noise: independent Gaussian voltage errors with declared sigma; original illustrative OCV shape
model.normalization: every stochastic transition and observation normalizer retained; outside-domain SOC probability raises an unresolved error instead of clipping
model.continuous_model_limit: SOC-grid transport and discrete health/thermal/nuisance support are explicit approximations; same-grid agreement alone cannot certify the continuous battery

representations: Single bivariate Gaussian support mass: quantized standardized thresholds and correlation, with a displacement/normal-distribution TV bound

Full joint discrete posterior: positive square-root mass on a unit sphere, max-normalized relative-amplitude lattice at8/12bits preserving support zeros and re-encoding idempotence; preliminary upward-lattice drift and repair preserved in development001
Small frozen dictionary of joint Gaussian shapes fitted to separate public training fixtures, plus an exact support bitmap; index, dictionary parameters and evaluation scratch counted separately
evaluation: Normalizers, monotone paths, time/exposure semigroup controls, covariance and unknown nuisance persistence
Chronological filter vs an explicit unmerged two-step path sum, with normalization and all joint coordinates
Held-out weak/driven/temperature-reversal fixtures, quantizing after each update; no truth-guided centering or dictionary retraining on held-out data
Exact finite-grid TV, Hellinger angle, covariance and SOC/Q mean distortion; explicit conservative accumulated TV ledger
SOC-grid refinement reported independently of compression error; no arbitrary NLL success threshold
Actual packed sizes, full dictionary cost and Python peak memory; no index-only SRAM claim
qualification_limit: Finite mathematical/numerical controls and comparative measurements, not posterior coverage, physical aging calibration, full SRAM or lifetime qualification
